name: mrp__retransmit_on_lost_report
description: Locks the MRP retransmit pump per Matter §4.12.6: when a peer fails to ACK an outbound Reliable Report (NeedsAck=true) within MRPBackoffBase, the bridge MUST re-ship the same datagram. The harness ships one CCU echo, drops the first outbound on the peer side, and asserts a retransmit lands on the same exchange. If MRP wiring breaks (tracker not engaged, retransmit pump stopped, backoff misconfigured) the second expect_tx times out.
